Experience upscale Westside living in this fully furnished, designer-appointed 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom coach house located at W 16th Ave & Blenheim St. Nestled on the vibrant border of Kitsilano, Arbutus, and Point Grey, this private residence offers premium finishes, air conditioning, and a fully equipped home gym.

Whether you are a relocating professional, a visiting academic, or exploring the Lower Mainland, this turn-key home serves as your ultimate luxury Vancouver base.

Premium Features & Interior Amenities

* Chef's Kitchen: Equipped with stainless steel appliances, premium stone countertops, and custom millwork.
* Climate Control: Stay comfortable year-round with built-in air conditioning (AC).
* Luxury Millwork: Features elegant custom millwork and high-end built-ins throughout the home.
* Entertainment & Living: Relax in a living space featuring a comfortable sofa bed (perfect for guests) and two large HD smart TVs.
* Private Fitness Center: Access a fully equipped home gym complete with a premium functional trainer.

Outdoor Living & Entry

* Private Deck: Includes premium exterior patio furniture, a dining table, and a BBQ for effortless outdoor dining.
* Serene Entry: Features a private entrance adjacent to a beautifully landscaped, tranquil backyard.

Prime Westside Location

* Neighborhoods: Steps from Kitsilano, Arbutus Ridge, and Point Grey.
* Proximity to UBC: Minutes away from the University of British Columbia—ideal for faculty, medical professionals, or researchers.
* Nature & Recreation: Easy access to local beaches, Pacific Spirit Regional Park forest trails, and neighborhood parks.
* Shopping & Dining: Surrounded by the trendy boutiques, cafes, and restaurants of West 4th, West Broadway, and West 10th Ave.
* Transit & Travel: Central location with seamless transit options to explore Downtown Vancouver and the entire Lower Mainland.

Rental Details & Inclusions

* All-Inclusive Living: Monthly rent includes high-speed Wi-Fi, all utilities, and hot water.
* Parking & Power: Comes with dedicated EV charging capabilities.
* Lease Terms: Minimum 3-month stay.
